A Wind Energy Technician or Engineer installs, maintains, and optimises wind turbines — both onshore and offshore.

stacks, and hydrogen storage infrastructure. They work at the cutting edge of clean energy — developing the technology

An Energy Storage / Battery Technology Engineer designs, tests, and optimises battery systems for electric vehicles,
